scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai, main Paani hoon! Tera asli dost, sun le meri baat!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, मैं पानी हूँ! तेरा असली दोस्त, सुन ले मेरी बात!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Log mujhe ignore marte hain, par main hoon sabka aadhaar!
scenes.say: लोग मुझे इग्नोर मारते हैं, पर मैं हूँ सबका आधार!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Paani ki kami se na, bade-bade lafde ho jaate hain, bhidu!
scenes.say: पानी की कमी से ना, बड़े-बड़े लफड़े हो जाते हैं, भिडू!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Kabhi-kabhi thak jaata hai, ya sar ghoomta hai tera?
scenes.say: कभी-कभी थक जाता है, या सर घूमता है तेरा?

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Ho sakta hai, tune mujhko kam bulaaya ho, mere dost!
scenes.say: हो सकता है, तूने मुझको कम बुलाया हो, मेरे दोस्त!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Thoda paani pee le, dekh, ek dum se mast ho jaayega!
scenes.say: थोड़ा पानी पी ले, देख, एक दम से मस्त हो जाएगा!

scenes.image: A tiny, shimmering, transparent blue water droplet character. She has sparkly eyes, small delicate arms and legs, and a cute pink flower headband. She looks nimble and wise. [[BOOND DIDI]]
scenes.speaker: BOOND DIDI
scenes.line: Main boond hoon, chhoti si, par badi baat bolungi, suno!
scenes.say: मैं बूँद हूँ, छोटी सी, पर बड़ी बात बोलूँगी, सुनो!

scenes.image: A tiny, shimmering, transparent blue water droplet character. She has sparkly eyes, small delicate arms and legs, and a cute pink flower headband. She looks nimble and wise. [[BOOND DIDI]]
scenes.speaker: BOOND DIDI
scenes.line: Yeh jo ghoot-ghoot peene ka tareeka hai na, woh ekdum sahi hai!
scenes.say: ये जो घूट-घूट पीने का तरीका है ना, वो एकदम सही है!

scenes.image: A tiny, shimmering, transparent blue water droplet character. She has sparkly eyes, small delicate arms and legs, and a cute pink flower headband. She looks nimble and wise. [[BOOND DIDI]]
scenes.speaker: BOOND DIDI
scenes.line: Saara din thoda-thoda peete rehne ka, bas, tension nahi lene ka!
scenes.say: सारा दिन थोड़ा-थोड़ा पीते रहने का, बस, टेंशन नहीं लेने का!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Aur yeh sar dard ka kya bolega? Bahut pareshaan karta hai na?
scenes.say: और ये सर दर्द का क्या बोलेगा? बहुत परेशान करता है ना?

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Kai baar toh, dehydration ka hi chakkar hota hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: कई बार तो, डिहाइड्रेशन का ही चक्कर होता है, भिडू!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Thoda paani de de body ko, aur dekh, magic ho jaayega!
scenes.say: थोड़ा पानी दे दे बॉडी को, और देख, मैजिक हो जाएगा!

scenes.image: A tiny, shimmering, transparent blue water droplet character. She has sparkly eyes, small delicate arms and legs, and a cute pink flower headband. She looks nimble and wise. [[BOOND DIDI]]
scenes.speaker: BOOND DIDI
scenes.line: Par ek baat aur hai, zyaada bhi nahi karne ka, sab balance mein!
scenes.say: पर एक बात और है, ज़्यादा भी नहीं करने का, सब बैलेंस में!

scenes.image: A tiny, shimmering, transparent blue water droplet character. She has sparkly eyes, small delicate arms and legs, and a cute pink flower headband. She looks nimble and wise. [[BOOND DIDI]]
scenes.speaker: BOOND DIDI
scenes.line: Aur agar koi bada lafda lage na, toh seedha doctor ke paas jaao!
scenes.say: और अगर कोई बड़ा लफड़ा लगे ना, तो सीधा डॉक्टर के पास जाओ!

scenes.image: A tiny, shimmering, transparent blue water droplet character. She has sparkly eyes, small delicate arms and legs, and a cute pink flower headband. She looks nimble and wise. [[BOOND DIDI]]
scenes.speaker: BOOND DIDI
scenes.line: Hum toh bas gyaan dete hain, asal ilaaj toh doctor hi karega!
scenes.say: हम तो बस ज्ञान देते हैं, असल इलाज तो डॉक्टर ही करेगा!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Toh samjha na, mera jalwa! Main hoon tera health partner!
scenes.say: तो समझा ना, मेरा जलवा! मैं हूँ तेरा हेल्थ पार्टनर!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
scenes.line: Mujhe peeta rahega toh, tu rahega ekdum fit aur fine!
scenes.say: मुझे पीता रहेगा तो, तू रहेगा एकदम फिट और फाइन!

scenes.image: A cute, chubby, light-blue water bottle character with big friendly eyes, a smiling mouth, small arms and legs, and a bright red "Hero" headband. He looks sturdy and reliable. [[PAANI BHAI]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI BHAI
